items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: When Mosby and I went together in the music store, he was our salesman--outside salesman.

ctx.x: Oh, no, I didn't know. I only knew about the two.

Yeah, the one of them was...uh...oh, I can't... he died here. He was...uh, he had one eye. He...oh, I can't think of his name. When Mosby and I went together in the music store, he was our salesman--outside salesman. He went around and sold phonographs and things on the outside.
Was he involved in performing at all?
